profile.headline: SWE @ Meta
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Charlie (he/him)
I love working on projects from the ground up, and taking ownership on large complex tasks. I’m most passionate about building user facing experiences, or features that directly impact users.

With my expertise in Django, React, JavaScript, Python, and SCSS, I've designed, developed, and maintained full-stack applications, initiated and led the development of new features, and responded to both customer requests and urgent bugs to maintain product stability.

In my free time, I enjoy taking walks in the city, finding new cafes to visit on weekends, and reading in the park.

Feel free to reach out to learn more about my projects and experiences. I look forward to connecting with you!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owner and lead developer of Analytics and Performance platforms, generating over $1m in revenue in <200 days. Leading team retrospectives, identifying team goals, and hosting lunch and learn series. Onboarding and mentoring new engineers. Leading small teams towards product and feature roadmap goals. Volunteer culture ambassador, leading recurring team-building events including game days, team bonding, etc. Writing technical documentation, leading design discussions, and tech debt/bug bashes. 
Full stack product software engineer using Django, React, Javascript, Python, SCSS.
Initiating and leading new feature development to increase user engagement.
Designing, building, and testing new features from ideation to deployment.
Responding to customer feature requests, investigating and fixing time sensitive bugs throughout the product.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack RESTful web service application development.
Developing automated tools to increase workflow efficiency and remotely monitor cluster health.
Supporting and maintaining company cloud platform.
Monitoring cluster health and build proactive tools to look for anomalous behavior.
Supporting multiple petabyte scale production clusters.
Coordinating and monitoring cluster upgrade needs.

Collaborated with team members to conduct manual research, hit 120% of daily research goals for duration of Internship.

projects.title: Weather Station Build
projects.description: Raspberry Pi Weather Station build with remote access and realtime data collection and display. Using hardware to update environment and location data, and DarkSky's API to gather data on local weather trends. Automated error handling and remediation to improve reliability.
